kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-app-agent-template --app-id ac7N0000 --name '智能体模版' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppAgentTemplate

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can find this ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_zh:
智能体类型：
1: 语音通话（默认）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The chat mode.

`1`: Natural Conversation Mode (default)

`2`: Walkie-talkie Mode
parameters.help_zh:
对话模式：
1: 自然对话模式（默认）
2: 对讲机模式
parameters.name: chat_mode

parameters.help_en:
The interrupt mode.

`1`: Allows interruption (default)

`2`: Disallows interruption
parameters.help_zh:
打断方式：
1: 支持打断（默认）
2: 禁止打断
parameters.name: interrupt_mode

parameters.help_en: The greeting message. Maximum length: 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 问候语，最大长度不超过500
parameters.name: greeting

fields.help_en: The silence duration threshold, in milliseconds (ms), for detecting the end of a sentence. Valid range: [200, 6000]. Default: 500
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，默认500ms，允许范围[200，6000]
fields.name: max_sentence_silence

fields.help_en: The configuration name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The minimum duration of human speech in milliseconds (ms) that triggers an interruption. This helps prevent accidental interruptions. Valid range: [0, 3000]. Default: 300
fields.help_zh: 人声持续阈值 (ms)，取值范围为[0,3000]。持续检测到人声信号的最小时间长度，避免误打断。默认300ms
fields.name: interrupt_speech_duration

fields.help_en: The voice activity detection (VAD) settings
fields.help_zh: vad配置
fields.name: vad_config

fields.help_en:
The language code. If not specified, the large language model (LLM) automatically detects the language.

`zh`: Chinese

`en`: English
fields.help_zh:
语言代码。可不写，大模型会自动设别。
zh: 中文
en: 英文
fields.name: lang

fields.help_en: The weight of the hotword. Must be an integer from 1 to 5. A common value is 4. A higher weight boosts the recognition probability of the hotword but may reduce the accuracy for other words
fields.help_zh:
热词权重，取值范围为[1, 5]之间的整数。
常用值：4。
如果效果不明显可以适当增加权重，但是当权重较大时可能会引起负面效果，导致其他词语识别不准确
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The hotword. It must be UTF-8 encoded, contain no punctuation or special characters, and be at most 10 Chinese characters or 10 English words long. The hotword is ignored if these requirements are not met
fields.help_zh: 热词文本，每个词语最长10个汉字或英文单词
fields.name: word

fields.help_en: A list of up to 500 hotword objects to improve recognition accuracy
fields.help_zh:
每个词表最多包含500个热词，每个热词中文长度不超过10个字符。
热词必须为UTF-8编码，不能包含标点、特殊字符，不符合的情况下，无热词效果
fields.name: word_weights

fields.help_en: The ID of the Model Studio agent
fields.help_zh: 百炼智能体ID
fields.name: agent_app_id

fields.help_en: The API key required by the LLM vendor
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The number of previous conversation turns to provide as context for the LLM. Maximum: 100. Default: 50
fields.help_zh: 给大模型提供多少历史对话轮次，最大100，默认值50
fields.name: history_depth

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the output. Default: 8192
fields.help_zh: 输出文本的最大限制，默认值8192
fields.name: max_token

fields.help_en: The configuration name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.example: 你是一个高级心理医生。
fields.help_en: The system prompt for the LLM. Maximum length: 5000 characters
fields.help_zh: 大模型提示词，最大长度为5000
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en: The sampling temperature. A higher value makes the output more random, while a lower value makes it more deterministic. Valid range: [0, 2). Default: 0.7
fields.help_zh: 采样温度，取值范围[0,2)，默认值0.7
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The nucleus sampling probability. The model considers the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds this value. Valid range: (0, 1]. Default: 0.8
fields.help_zh: 采样的选择范围(0,1]，默认值0.8
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The endpoint URL for a third-party LLM
fields.help_zh: 接入第三方大模型时，该字段表示接入的endpoint
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The LLM vendor. Supported vendors include Alibaba Cloud's Model Studio and third-party models compatible with the OpenAI API specification
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼和第三方配置（符合OpenAI接口规范）
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: The API key required by the text-to-speech service vendor
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en:
Specifies which types of brackets to filter from the text before synthesis.

`1`: Chinese parentheses (`（` `）`)

`2`: English parentheses (`(` `)`)

`3`: Chinese square brackets (`【` `】`)

`4`: English square brackets (`[` `]`)

`5`: English curly braces (`{` `}`)
fields.help_zh:
过滤设置。
1-中文刮号（）
2-英文刮号()
3-中文方刮号【】
4-英文方刮号[]
5-英文花刮号{}
fields.name: filter_brackets

fields.help_en: The configuration name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The pitch of the speech. Valid range: [0.5, 2.0]. Default: 1.0
fields.name: pitch

fields.help_en: The speech rate. Valid range: [0.5, 2.0]. Default: 1.0
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The text-to-speech vendor. Currently, only Alibaba Cloud (`aliyun`) is supported
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: The volume of the speech output. Valid range: [0, 100]. Default: 50
fields.help_zh: 音量，取值范围[0~100]，默认50
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The timeout in seconds for triggering a silence alert. The alert is recurring: if the agent remains silent, it will trigger again after each timeout period. Valid range: [5, 600]. A value of `0` (the default) disables this feature
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的超时时间（单位：秒）。
可能多次触发，若智能体静默提醒超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[5, 600]，默认值0，0表示不提醒
fields.name: alert_timeout

fields.help_en: The text of the silence prompt
fields.help_zh: 静默提示消息的内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The strategy for handling silence timeouts. Valid values:
`1`: Plays the prompt from `Content` for the user. (Default)
`2`: Sends the prompt from `Content` and the conversation history to the LLM, and plays the generated response.
fields.help_zh:
静默超时处理策略。
1 - 向用户语音播报content指定的提示消息
2 - 把content指定的提示消息和历史对话发送给LLM，并播报模型生成的回复
默认值：1
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The timeout in seconds for triggering a silence webhook. The trigger is recurring: if the agent remains silent, the webhook will trigger again after each timeout period. Valid range: [10, 600]. A value of `0` (the default) disables this feature
fields.help_zh: 触发智能体静默超时webhook的静默超时时间（单位：秒）。可能多次触发，若智能体webhook静默超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[10, 600]，默认值0，0表示不触发
fields.name: webhook_trigger_timeout

parameters.help_en: The configuration for handling agent silence
parameters.name: agent_silence_config

fields.help_en:
The ID of the ambient sound. Available built-in sounds include:
- `white_noise`
- `office`
fields.help_zh:
agent提供以下默认环境音：
    - white_noise 
    - office
fields.name: sound_id

fields.help_en: The volume of the ambient sound
fields.help_zh: 音量大小
fields.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The configuration for ambient sound. This feature is disabled by default
parameters.help_zh: 智能体环境音配置。不传表示不使用环境配置
parameters.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable semantic interruption
fields.help_zh: 按语义打断
fields.name: semantics_interrupt

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the backchannel feature
fields.help_zh: 是否开启承接词
fields.name: user_turn_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable video understanding. If enabled, the LLM must support multimodal input
parameters.help_zh: 如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据
parameters.name: enable_video_understanding

parameters.help_en:
If video understanding is enabled, this parameter specifies which video stream the agent processes. Since the agent can only process one stream at a time, this setting determines the priority when both the camera and screen sharing streams are active.

`1`: The agent prioritizes the camera stream.

`2`: The agent prioritizes the screen sharing stream.

By default, the camera stream is prioritized
parameters.help_zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。
智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流

1 - 智能体优先理解Camera流；

2 - 智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流
parameters.name: prefer_video
